title: Pearl Abyss sold the creators of EVE Online for much less than it purchased them for
summary: The company Pearl Abyss will no longer own CCP Games. It has announced that it is selling the studio back to its management.

title: Report: Spiders studio may shut down after 18 eears of operation
summary: At the end of March, Nacon put up Spiders for sale — the studio known for GreedFall and Steelrising. However, according to the French portal Origami, no one showed interest in purchasing it.

title: Digital Bros has acquired the rights to Wuchang: Fallen Feathers
summary: Digital Bros is the parent company of publisher 505 Games, which released the soulslike game Wuchang: Fallen Feathers last year. The company announced a deal with the developers of the game from the Chinese studio Leenzee.

title: People Can Fly acquired a publisher founded by veterans of Gearbox Publishing
summary: In 2024, a group of former employees from Gearbox Publishing decided to establish their own publishing company — Cooldown Games. For nearly two years, it operated with indie status and has now become part of the Polish company People Can Fly.

title: “Players are frustrated” — Microsoft Gaming has rebranded back to Xbox and promised to adjust its strategy
summary: The head of Microsoft’s gaming division, Asha Sharma, and the content director, Matt Booty, published a statement detailing plans for the future development of their team.
